name: transient-pairing-preservation
body:
Preserving transient pairings across a durable mutation. A durable node/edge mutation's projection apply must, after deleting the mutation's exact FQN/edge delta, re-merge the assembled transient record set — the plan store plus every transient tier mirror — not the durable record set alone. Every pre-existing transient pairing incident to a changed FQN (in particular a `Feedback-[:Reviews]` edge) must survive the mutation with no transient write in between, so the projection remains equal to the durable layers plus the plan store plus all transient mirrors.

When it does not, the projection stops matching the transient feedback mirror: a subsequent `apg review list` (and the `apg_review` suite tool, which shells out to it) hides the item — its `Feedback` node survives but its `Reviews` edge is gone — until a transient write re-projects the pairing. The verify gate is not affected: it loads the plan store, never DB `Reviews` edges, so its `all feedback resolved` check cannot be skewed by this. No code re-scan is involved.
